server_binary: cmd/voiceservice built with production defaults (no source changes)

scenarios.purpose: Confirm each configured limit individually rejects overflow with a stable error code.
scenarios.expectation: commit (all five limit rejections observed with stable codes)
findings: source at exactly 32 MiB accepted (status 201)
source one frame over 32 MiB rejected: status 413 code source_too_large
~49.4 MiB request body rejected: status 413 code request_too_large
65-span timeline rejected: status 422 code invalid_span_count
timeline one frame over the output cap rejected: status 413 code timeline_too_long

scenarios.purpose: Ordinary register/compose/render/read mix with detail-read latency distribution.
Register the largest legal source (32 MiB) and read it back.
One 32 MiB stereo source rendered to a near-cap single-span output (legal near-limit production path).
findings: single-source near-cap output: 8388597 frames, 33554432 output bytes
verdict_reasons: peak RSS 459.7 MiB is above the 384 MiB commit ceiling

scenarios.purpose: Sixteen 1 MiB sources composed to a near-cap output frame count (legal near-limit production path).
findings: 16-source near-cap output: 8316256 frames

scenarios.purpose: Timeline at the 64-span cap with 64 small distinct sources.
Two 32 MiB sources rendered to a near-cap output; probes the combined source+output envelope.
findings: two-source near-cap output: 8595200 frames
verdict_reasons: peak RSS 497.3 MiB is above the 384 MiB commit ceiling

scenarios.purpose: 64 spans over 64 distinct 4 MiB sources (256 MiB of registered media); predicted to exceed the 512 MiB budget.
findings: render completed unconstrained; peak RSS is the over-budget evidence
verdict_reasons: peak RSS 870.4 MiB exceeds the 512 MiB budget

scenarios.purpose: Same combination under GOMEMLIMIT=460MiB to capture the enforced-budget failure signature.
scenarios.expectation: gap (job fails or client times out; output stays unavailable)
findings: under GOMEMLIMIT=460MiB the render ended "completed" (job error ""); output GET status 200; VmHWM still reached the value recorded below
verdict_reasons: peak RSS 814.1 MiB exceeds the 512 MiB budget

scenarios.purpose: A 40 MiB request body trickled at 0.5 MiB/s must be cut by the server ReadTimeout (60s).
findings: server stopped reading at 1m0s (ReadTimeout) and answered status 422 code "invalid_json"
rejected upload left no source: GET /v1/sources/src_slow = 404
verdict_reasons: a 40 MiB request body at 0.5 MiB/s cannot be delivered within the 60s ReadTimeout

scenarios.purpose: Two concurrent 32 MiB registrations; probes HTTP-layer memory multiplication at low concurrency.
findings: 2 concurrent max-size registrations finished in 437ms wall time

scenarios.purpose: Three concurrent 32 MiB registrations; probes the concurrency commit boundary.
findings: 3 concurrent max-size registrations finished in 548ms wall time
verdict_reasons: peak RSS 491.5 MiB is above the 384 MiB commit ceiling

scenarios.purpose: Four concurrent 32 MiB registrations; predicted to exceed the 512 MiB budget.
findings: 4 concurrent max-size registrations finished in 671ms wall time
verdict_reasons: peak RSS 580.4 MiB exceeds the 512 MiB budget

scenarios.purpose: Detail reads and a competing write probed while a large render holds the service mutex.
scenarios.expectation: commit or boundary (reads stay fast, writes queue behind the render)
findings: job state observed mid-render: "rendering"
verdict_reasons: peak RSS 435.1 MiB is above the 384 MiB commit ceiling

scenarios.purpose: Four concurrent downloads of a 32 MiB render output served by a fresh instance; isolates read-path memory multiplication.
verdict_reasons: peak RSS 459.4 MiB is above the 384 MiB commit ceiling

scenarios.purpose: SIGKILL the server mid-render (hard enforcement proxy), restart on the same data dir, and record the observable wreckage.
scenarios.expectation: gap (stale non-terminal job; output unavailable; render id wedged)
findings: render PUT observed the kill as: Put "http://127.0.0.1:33815/v1/renders/rnd_crash": EOF
after SIGKILL + restart the render job reads back as state "rendering"
receipt GET = 409, output GET = 409 code "render_not_completed"
idempotent replay of the wedged render id returned status 200 with state "rendering"
a fresh render id on the same timeline completed and downloaded correctly
verdict_reasons: hard kill leaves the render job in non-terminal state "rendering" with no automatic recovery
render id rnd_crash is wedged in state "rendering"; idempotent replay cannot re-drive it
